Summary:

5 Bikes-300 Yards to Frog Pool/Seasonally Heated! 'Mykonos on the Gulf'



The Space:

✨ QUICK HIGHLIGHTS:



✔ Six-Seater Golf Cart Rental Option- quick and easy transportation

✔ Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected 📶

✔ Spacious Open Floor Plan – Ideal for families & groups 🏡

✔ Lake District Location – Tranquil & scenic 🌿

✔ Access to WaterColor Amenities – Including pools, parks & trails 🌊

✔ 7 Bikes Included! – Cruise around WaterColor & Seaside 🚲

✔ Propane Grill – Perfect for cookouts 🍔🔥

✔ Parking for 3 Vehicles – Plus guest parking throughout WaterColor 🚗

✔ Community Pools – Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, & Sandhill (Frog Pool) all heated in winter 🏊‍♂️

✔ Professionally Managed – 24/7 Guest Support 🏡







🏠Welcome to Mykonos on the Gulf



The Watercolor vacation home, Mykonos on the Gulf, offers an expansive and thoughtfully designed space perfect for family getaways or quiet retreats. The main house features a spacious floor plan with a large double living room, ideal for relaxing and enjoying time together. The full kitchen, equipped with custom finishes and stainless steel appliances, opens to a generous dining area with seating for up to 13—8 at the dining table and 5 at the kitchen counter—creating the perfect setting for shared meals. Guests can retreat to one of three serene, screened-in porches, ideal for enjoying a good book or taking in the surrounding natural beauty.



The first floor includes a luxurious master suite with a king bed and private bathroom. Throughout the home, the open floor concept and premium craftsmanship shine, with three additional master suites featuring king beds and en-suite bathrooms. A fourth bedroom comfortably accommodates up to six guests with a queen bed, a full-size bunk bed, and two twin bunk beds, while a bonus room offers additional sleeping space with two queen bunk beds. The home is beautifully appointed with quartz countertops, wide-plank hardwood flooring, nickel-gap tongue and groove walls, and modern features like surround sound. Large screened porches overlook a peaceful nature preserve, adding to the home’s charm. Conveniently located in Phase 3, it’s just steps from the famous Frog Pool and only half a mile from the Town Center and beach, making it easy to explore Watercolor using the street-legal golf cart or complimentary bikes.



Nestled beside the main house, the charming 1-bedroom carriage house offers extra space for extended family or group members. With a fully equipped kitchen, washer/dryer, and thoughtful amenities, it combines the comforts of home with a touch of elegance. When paired with the main house, this property delivers the ideal blend of luxury, relaxation, and convenience, ensuring an unforgettable stay at Mykonos on the Gulf.



***Watercolor Amenities***

A total of 14 wristbands are allowed for the main and carriage house. Watercolor requires 1 wristband per person.

Children under the age of 5 do not need a wristband. The wristbands will be located inside the property.



Golf Carts: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW:

-To operate the golf cart, guests must have a valid drivers license and be at least 21 years old.

-Please be aware of the golf cart rules and regulations

-A copy of the golf carts terms and conditions will be emailed upon reservation and will require signatures

**Golf cart rental is not guaranteed. Should the golf cart need to be serviced, a backup golf cart will not be provided. Guest will receive a refund for days golf cart is inoperable. **

PLEASE NOTE - ** FL law states that any underage and/or unlicensed driver of a street legal golf cart is considered a criminal offense and a $500 fine including a possible 60 days in jail. It’s a very serious offense for underage/unlicensed driving of a LSV in the State of FL.**

***Watercolor does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors. All carts must be reserved through their exclusive vendor Electric Cart Company or offered through the property owner. ***



Watercolor Resort is a family-friendly, 499-acre coastal resort, tucked between the Gulf of Mexico and a coastal dune lake framed by a long leaf pine forest. Throughout the beautifully landscaped grounds, trails wind through stunning parks, green spaces, several pools, playgrounds, tennis courts, boutiques, restaurants, and a private beach located along Scenic 30A. Watercolor boasts five miles of biking and walking trails around the community, including Western Lake, play grounds, climbing structures, basketball court; the boathouse sits on Western Lake and has a park and offers fitness classes as well as paddle boards, kayak’s & canoe rentals.



No Pets! No Smoking! No Parties! The primary renter must be at least 25 years old with a ratio of one adult over 25 per 3 under 25 during spring break and summer seasons.



**30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival.**







SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS



MAIN HOUSE (12 guests):

Downstairs Master: King sized bed, private en suite bath with walk in shower

Upstairs Master: King sized bed, private en suite bath with stand-up shower and claw foot tub, private screened in porch.

Upstairs Master: King sized bed, private en suite bath with walk in shower

Guest bedroom: Twin over Twin bunk bed and 1 Queen, 1 Double Hanging Bunk Bed

Bonus room: Queen over Queen bunk bed



CARRIAGE HOUSE (4 guests)



Guest Room: King sized bed



Livingroom: Queen sized sofa sleeper







AREA ATTRACTIONS:

Watercolor Beach is located in the heart of 30A. Within walking, biking distance to the shops and dining Seaside and Watercolor Beach have to offer. Watercolor Beach is a 499-acre community that boasts 5 community pools, tennis courts, beach access, Western Lake access and miles of walking/biking trails.

Watercolor is also the perfect place to celebrate a special occasion. Go gourmet at Fish Out of Water, an award-winning restaurant; or sip one of many wines offered at Chan’s Wine World. Pamper yourself at a luxurious spa or pick up the perfect outfit at The Fuss boutique.

- Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.

- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community

- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways

- Pristine sugar sand beaches

- 4 swimming pools (Community Pool Heated Seasonally)

- Award-winning tennis facilities

- Championship golf nearby

- World Famous Beach Club

- Unparalleled beachside, poolside and lakeside dining

- Acres of parks, gardens and foot paths

- Nearby state parks and preserves



Need more or less space? Check out the carriage house at Mykonos on the Gulf ||. Or rent just the main house by itself!



Other Things to Note:

House Rules

**No Pets!**

**No Smoking!**

**No Parties!**

**The primary renter must be at least 25 years old**

**No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25**

**30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
